_about: DMA environments. Server: DMA_ENV=<name> in server/.env (default production). Agent + Admin Console exes: build.ps1 -Env <name>. hrmsApiUrl = EktaHR login service; onlineServerUrl = online DMA server agents and office consoles also connect to (empty = office LAN only); useDatabase = whether MONGODB_URI (old DEV_HRMS database) may be used for logins.
